item.title: People with ME/CFS and Long COVID experience disruption to brain connectivity
item.description: People with Myalgic Encephalomyelitis/Chronic Fatigue Syndrome (ME/CFS) and Long COVID experience a disruption to their brain connectivity during a mentally demanding task.

item.title: Gut microbiome may be a central player in the body's response to cancer
item.description: A new study reveals how bacteria in the gut can help determine whether the amino acid asparagine from the diet will feed tumor growth or activate immune cells against the cancer​, according to researchers at Weill Cornell Medicine.

item.title: Remote cognitive and occupational therapy shows promise for improving stroke recovery
item.description: In the U.S., a stroke happens roughly every 40 seconds. That means, in the time it takes to read a five-minute news article, more than seven Americans will have experienced this life-changing medical event, which is a leading cause of death and serious long-term disability across the country.

item.title: Genetic inheritance and life experience leave distinct epigenetic marks in immune cells
item.description: The COVID-19 pandemic gave us tremendous perspective on how wildly symptoms and outcomes can vary between patients experiencing the same infection.

item.title: Data-driven modeling uncovers dynamic genome folding in three dimensions
item.description: Chromosomes are masters of organization. These long strings of DNA fold down into an ensemble of compact structures that keep needed parts of the genome accessible while tucking away those that aren't used as often.

item.title: Lab-grown corticospinal neurons offer new models for ALS and spinal injuries
item.description: Researchers have developed a way to grow a highly specialized subset of brain nerve cells that are involved in motor neuron disease and damaged in spinal injuries.

item.title: Oral cancer pain and opioid tolerance share a common EGFR mechanism
item.description: Epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) signaling in the tissue around oral cancers both increases nerve sensitivity and makes opioids less effective, according to new research published in Science Signaling.

item.title: Evosep launches IQ/OQ protocols for the Evosep Eno System at WCBP 2026
item.description: Evosep is proud to announce a major advancement in quality assurance for pharmaceutical and regulated laboratories with the introduction of Installation Qualification (IQ) and Operational Qualification (OQ) protocols for its Evosep Eno system.

item.title: Sino Biological expands research reagent portfolio to support global Nipah virus vaccine and diagnostic development
item.description: Recent reports of Nipah virus (NiV) infections in West Bengal, India, have reignited global concern, prompting public health authorities to prioritize research into this high-mortality pathogen.
